root_cause.summary: Deploy d-0170 (1.16.0) added an in-memory price-quote cache with no TTL and no max entries; heap grows about 16 MB per minute until the container is OOMKilled at 1024 MB, about every 40 minutes.

ruled_out.why: heap_mb already climbs at the same rate from 06:41 with low rps; the first OOMKilled is hours before the peak
requests between the OOM events return 200 with normal latency

proposed_action.step: A. Roll back d-0170 by on-call; B. PR adding a TTL and max entries to the price-quote cache

blast_radius: checkout-api only: a short 503 burst at each OOM event, about every 40 minutes; other services unaffected; sample data
open: Which TTL keeps quotes correct? Ask the pricing owner.
